tei:div.tei:p: (175)'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ nam mkha'i gnas su nam mkha' gang ba yi/

sogs kyi skyabs 'gro dang*/ bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams/ sogs/ sems bskyed bya/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ sogs/ yan lag bdun pa sngon du song nas/ āḥ chos rnams stong pa byang chub sems/ dmigs med snying rje chen po'i gdangs/ zung 'jug sngags kyi yi ger shar/ pho rakṣa ku ru bhrūm̐/ de las 'od 'phros rgyal ba rnams/ bskul zhing byin rlabs nus pa kun/ bsdus shing brtan pas yongs gyur pa/ 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das mtshams/ dngas gas rin chen rgya mtsho'i steng*/ sa bdag klu gnyan gzas po'i zhing*/ mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'i pho brang che/ klu chen brgyad kyis kha bad dang*/ gdugs pa'i ro nye dral gdung gis/ gnam pa steg 'og khyab pa'i dbus/ rigs lnga'i klu 'bum pa bdag stong*/ gnyan 'bum bcal du bkram pa'i steng*/ 'jam dpal khros pa'i ngo bo nyid/ nā ga rakṣa ti pa tsa/ mthing nag stong zil bcag pa'i mdog dbu (176)dgu za byed srin pa'i gdong*/ stong nyid bcu drug phyag gis mjes/ ri rab lta bur brjid pa'i sku/ sku stod srin pa'i gzugs nyid la/ ri rab lhun por bsten pa'i tshul/ sku smad g.yu sbrul rgya mtshor 'khril/ sbrul mgo dgu yi gdengs ka yi/ dbus mar nyi zla padma'i steng*/ bla ma rdo rje mi bskyod pa/ mthing gsal rdor dril thugs kar bsnol/ g.yas brgyad gcod pa'i gri gug phyir/ g.yon brgyad 'ching ba'i sbrul zhags bsnams/ gru gsum zhal nas ig sha sgrog klu dang sde brgyad gshed mar gyur/ gnas gsum 'jam dpal spyan ras gzigs/ badzra pa ṇi dkar dmar mthing*/ rigs 'dus rgyal ba'i sku la rdzogs/ rang las shar ba'i ye shes lha/ ye nas ma bskyed lhun gyis grub/ dam tshig ye shes gnyis su med/ cho 'phrul bsam yas mjad pa'i tshogs/ mos pas rjes su dran pas 'dud/ dbyings las rol pa shar ba yi/ snang srid snod bcud skye 'gro kun/ ye nas 'dod yon rgyan du bzhes/

khyad par dug gsum nyon mongs las/ byung ba'i sa bdag klu gnyan rnams/ (177)sdong zla sde brgyad sngon las dang*/ glo bur rbad 'dre rbod gtor kun/ drag po e yi zhal du bstobs/ dug gsum lhag ma med par bzhes/ dmigs med dbyings su sbyangs nas su/ drag sngags mthu yi dngos grub stsol/ mnyam nyid sku ni 'jam dpal dbyangs/ 'gro la brtse bas thugs kyi sbrul/ klu gshed nā gar rakṣa ston/ dug gsum 'joms pa'i byed por bstod/ bsnyen pa ni/ phyag na rdo rje'i thugs kar gnam lcags kyi rdo rje'i lte bar phe yig gi mthar/ oṃ phe lam hūm̐/ zhes pas bskor bar bsam la/ 'bum phrag bcur bzla'o/ de nas las sbyor la spyi bye brag gnyis las/ rtsa sngags mthar/ nag mo ti pa tsa ya nā ga rakṣa oṃ phe lam hūm̐/ zhes btags nas bzlas pa ni spyir bstan pa'o/ bye brag klu'i sdong zla sde brgyad gnad la 'bebs pa'i sngags rnams ni rgyud las shes so/ 'di ha cang thal drag na lus la shu ba 'byung bar yang gsungs pas gdon bros pa'i rtags dang lha nye ba'i rtags kyi bye brag phyed pa gces so/ thun bsdu ba na/ snod bcud rim gyis 'od du zhu/ sngags phreng phe yig nyid la thim/ de yang skad (178)cig 'od du yal/ spros bral 'jam dpal rang zhal blta/ rjes su lhar ldang spyod lam bya/ dge ba dmigs med rgya yis 'debs/ 'di ltar nā ga rakṣa yi/ rgyun khyer zung ngur byas pa ni/ a khu sgur le ngo ra ma/ klu nad mje la skrag che nas/ rmi ltas ngan pas sems ma bde/ mje rigs yod pas gnyid ma khug rnam rtog che bas smyo la khad/ nyin re bzhin du 'ur long nas/ dom snyags bzhin tu brgyug brgyug nas/ bla ma tshul khrims rgya mtsho zhes/ chos med snyoms las za nyal mkhan/ 'chal gtam g.yeng bas 'da' zhor du/ lag pa na yang 'bad nas bris/ dge bas 'gro ba rko rba can/ rnam rtog nad las thar gyur cig dge'o/ maṅga laṃ/// /
